## Discovery & Translational Science

- **Fatal base editing attempt for Snijders Blok-Campeau syndrome reported** [Science](https://www.science.org/content/blog-post/we-only-know-her-mei)
  - An unreported patient death occurred in Xinhua Hospital in China during an experimental base-editing attempt targeting a T-to-C point mutation in the `CHD3` gene in a six-year-old girl.
  - The trial was led by principal investigator Zilong Qiu; `CHD3` encodes a chromodomain helicase involved in a histone deacetylase complex for chromatin remodeling, mutations in which cause developmental delays and intellectual disability.

- **Niraparib and anti-HER2 ADC SYD985 demonstrate activity in endometrial cancer PDX models** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42551191/)
  - A patient-derived xenograft (PDX) mouse trial established broad anti-tumor efficacy for the PARP inhibitor niraparib and the anti-HER2 antibody-drug conjugate SYD985 (vc-seco-DUBA) in HER2/neu-expressing endometrial cancer models.

- **ERBB4 signaling in non-myocytes regulates post-MI cardiac scar dynamics** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.29.741639)
  - Deletion of `Erbb4` specifically in fibroblasts or myeloid cells in neonatal mice subjected to LAD ligation did not alter post-MI cardiomyocyte cell-cycle activity compared to wild-type controls.
  - However, non-myocyte `Erbb4` deficiency significantly altered myocardial scar size dynamics, capillary density, and regional left ventricular gene expression following injury.

- **Multimodal wrist sensors fail to improve non-invasive glucose forecasting over CGM alone** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.03.26359550)
  - A leakage-controlled evaluation across 15 participants showed 30-minute-ahead continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) forecasting saturates at a root-mean-square error (RMSE) of 13.90 ± 0.58 mg/dL.
  - Fusing non-invasive wrist-worn photoplethysmography, electrodermal activity, skin temperature, and accelerometry sequence features yielded no improvement in accuracy over CGM data alone (13.56 vs 13.60 mg/dL).

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

- **[Biotech]** **Rhythm Pharmaceuticals reports preliminary Phase 2 data for RM-718 in hypothalamic obesity** [X / BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2084594424164536326)
  - Preliminary Phase 2 data for RM-718 demonstrated a positive efficacy signal in patients with acquired hypothalamic obesity.
  - Treatment resulted in an 11.6% mean reduction in BMI from baseline at Week 16 in an initial cohort (n = 7).

- **[Biotech]** **Ideaya Biosciences to present Phase 1 and Phase 2 trial updates at ESMO** [X / BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2084580866005647640)
  - Ideaya will present updated Phase 2 clinical data from its ongoing OptimUM-01 and OptimUM-09 trials at the European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) congress.
  - The company will also report Phase 1 data for IDE849 in patients with small-cell lung cancer (SCLC) and neuroendocrine carcinomas.

## Regulatory & Approvals

- **[Biotech]** **Larimar Therapeutics initiates rolling BLA submission for CTI-1601** [X / BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2084596509794836600)
  - Initiated a rolling Biologics License Application (BLA) submission seeking accelerated approval, with the first module submitted and full submission completion targeted for 2H 2026.
  - The company reported holding $156M in cash and cash equivalents to support regulatory progress.

- **Liebel-Flarsheim recalls OPTIRAY contrast agent due to particulate contamination** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/liebel-flarsheim-company-llc-issues-recall-optiray-imaging-bulk-package-350-500ml-vial-nationwide)
  - Liebel-Flarsheim Company issued a nationwide voluntary recall for one lot of OPTIRAY Imaging Bulk Package 350 (ioversol injection 74%, 500 mL vials) due to foreign particulate matter including polyethylene, stainless steel, and glass.

- **FDA issues warning letters to drug manufacturers for CGMP violations** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/inspections-compliance-enforcement-and-criminal-investigations/warning-letters/abs-corporation-732115-07232026)
  - Issued warning letters to ABS Corporation, Woodbine Products Company, Dabur India Limited, and Thomas Brunner Hygiene GmbH citing significant current Good Manufacturing Practice (CGMP) violations for finished pharmaceuticals.

## Business & Strategy

- **[Big Pharma]** **Pfizer expands cost-reduction initiative targeting $6.7B in total savings** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/pfizer-cost-cuts-savings-2q-2026-earnings/826930/)
  - Added $1B in net savings through 2029 to its multi-year restructuring plan, expanding total targeted cuts to $6.7B ($1.5B specifically targeting manufacturing operations).
  - Reported Q2 revenue of $15B (+1% YoY), beating consensus estimates on 5% growth in non-COVID products, and raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance by $500M to $60.5B–$62.5B.

- **[Big Pharma]** **Merck reports $16.6B in Q2 sales led by Keytruda growth** [X / BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2084588440465629603)
  - Q2 worldwide revenue reached $16.6B, driven by $8.4B in combined sales from Keytruda and Keytruda Qlex1.
  - Increased full-year 2026 worldwide sales guidance to a range of $66.3B to $67.3B.

- **[Biotech]** **Aurora Therapeutics terminates custom CRISPR gene-editing platform** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/04/aurora-therapeutics-ends-program-baby-kj-treatments-beam-therapeutics-jennifer-doudna/?utm_campaign=rss)
  - Abruptly ended development plans for scaling custom, ultra-rare CRISPR therapies (such as N-of-1 treatments like Baby KJ) due to high regulatory clearance hurdles established by the FDA for early-stage biotechs.

- **[Biotech]** **Sionna Therapeutics readout poses competitive risk to Vertex's CF franchise** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/vertex-2q-2026-earnings-sionna-cystic-fibrosis-competition/826957/)
  - Sionna Therapeutics is approaching a Phase 2 readout for its lead cystic fibrosis therapy, positioning the candidate as a direct threat to Vertex's market position.
  - Vertex posted Q2 CF sales exceeding $3.2B and raised full-year 2026 guidance to $13.1B–$13.2B.

- **[Biotech]** **Krystal Biotech slumps following Vyjuvek revenue miss; J&J pharma head retires** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/johnson-taubert-krystal-vyjuvek-merck-prometheus-pathos-pluvicto/826859/)
  - Krystal Biotech shares fell nearly 30% after Q2 sales for topical gene therapy Vyjuvek (dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa) reached $119.2M (+24% YoY), missing Wall Street estimates by $2M.
  - Johnson & Johnson announced that Innovative Medicines chief Jennifer Taubert will retire after 21 years, with Tom Cavanaugh assuming leadership on September 1.

- **[Big Pharma]** **Gilead wins litigation over HIV drug development timing** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/04/biotech-news-gilead-wins-case-that-scrutinized-pace-of-drug-development/?utm_campaign=rss)
  - Won a court case that challenged the development timeline and commercial strategy of its tenofovir-based HIV drug franchise.

- **[Big Pharma]** **Eli Lilly expands early access program for obesity candidate retatrutide** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/08/04/lilly-expands-retatrutide-access-program-gilead-court-victory/?utm_campaign=rss)
  - Confirmed the expansion of its early access program to permit more patients to apply for treatment with retatrutide, its unapproved triple GIP/GLP-1/glucagon agonist.

- **[Biotech]** **Nurix Therapeutics earns $10M milestone payment from Sanofi** [X / BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2084595940220957130)
  - Received a $10M milestone payment from Sanofi under the companies' ongoing drug discovery partnership.

- **[Biotech]** **Grace Therapeutics completes $10M PIPE financing** [X / BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2084807614462914563)
  - Secured $10M in private placement funding through the issuance of common shares at $2.10 per share.

- **[Biotech]** **ImmunityBio reports Q2 product revenue of $50.7M** [X / BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2084603470586282454)
  - Reported Q2 net product revenue of $50.7M (up 92% year-over-year) and ended the period with $350M in cash reserves.

## Public Health & Policy

- **Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo exceeds 1,700 deaths** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/04/ebola-1700-deaths-eastern-congo-fastest-growing-outbreak/?utm_campaign=rss)
  - More than 1,700 people have died in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo during the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak recorded in the region.

- **Exemption of rare disease therapies from Medicare price pilots eliminates cost savings** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/05/cms-drug-pricing-pilot-programs-rare-disease-drugs/?utm_campaign=rss)
  - A policy analysis indicates that exempting orphan and rare disease drugs from Medicare drug-pricing pilots would eliminate the majority of projected savings on retail prescription drugs.

- **Senate opens inquiry into Trump administration oversight of kratom and tobacco** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/05/senator-ron-wyden-investigation-kennedy-flavored-vapes-kratom/?utm_campaign=rss)
  - A Senate investigation requested records from RFK Jr., Reynolds American, and Botanic Tonics regarding whether regulatory policies on flavored vapes and kratom were softened via quid pro quo arrangements.

- **Pre-biopsy MRI remains underutilized in US prostate cancer diagnostic workflows** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/05/prostate-cancer-screening-biopsy-vs-mri-debate/?utm_campaign=rss)
  - Updated clinical practice data shows pre-biopsy prostate MRI was performed in only approximately one-third of US prostate cancer cases in 2022, despite being standard of care across most Western nations.

- Biology & Health
    - [Healthcare Can’t Keep Getting More Expensive](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/rTBg3iIapvM) -- Health2Tech
        - Features Chris Moose discussing ongoing clinician shortages and rising healthcare costs.
        - Explores how artificial intelligence could force a major shift in the healthcare industry.
        - Focuses on the intersection of medical AI, healthtech innovation, and healthcare economics.
- Tech & Engineering
    - [Why Texas Won’t Stop Growing](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dzmoALgtB1Q) -- Wendover Productions
        - Promotes Ground News as a platform to compare news coverage, spot media bias, and avoid algorithms.
        - Outlines production credits, including writing by Sam Denby, Tristan Purdy, and Christine Benedetti, with editing by Alexander Williard.
        - Credits animation to Sara Stoltman, Gabriel Ferreras, Austin Glass, and Kate Ermolenkko, alongside sound design by Manni Simon and Dony Bullen.
- Other
    - [The Ring of Fire](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/gCnbYzYZRjg) -- CrashCourse
        - Identifies the Ring of Fire as a region bordering nearly the entire Pacific Ocean.
        - Notes that almost all of Earth's volcanic eruptions and some of the largest recorded earthquakes take place in this region.
        - Directs viewers to Crash Course Geology to learn about the geological factors that make the area so active.
